originalReadback.note: QA-owned original Renderer read diagnostic only. R0 is the caller's previously captured main RGBA array. R1 is read before hashes, metadata or Canvas state inspection; a differing R1 stops before any floor observation or R2. If requested, F reads the original source-created, already cached floor using getContext("2d") without options, then R2 reads the same main context. No tick, render, await, export, drawing, state setter, wrapper, new surface or asset is added. A floor read can itself materialize backing storage. Native function/brand observations and context attributes do not identify a GPU/backend or prove its behavior. State is inspected after the read sequence; no pre-read state snapshot or invisible clip/path equivalence is claimed. Hashes are bounded noncryptographic byte fingerprints, not source authenticity. This is neither a timing/performance acceptance nor presented FPS evidence. Any later PNG export is separate from R0 and cannot certify the exact R0 bytes.

drain.note: Event-driven QA-owned cleanup bookkeeping only. Register each owned Promise before wait, or synchronously/asynchronously within a retirement that has not yet completed. Promise/thenable identity is deduplicated across this tracker: only its first accepted retirement runs. A fulfilled/rejected producer is not complete until its retirement (including any returned Promise and newly registered followers) finishes. Producer rejection alone is not a cleanup failure. Capacity is a lifetime entry bound, including completed entries; rejected capacity registrations are not observed and remain the caller's cleanup responsibility. The first wait uses one overall deadline with no polling and returns one fixed immutable report. Timeout does not cancel producer/retirement Promises; already accepted and later capacity-eligible followers continue best-effort, and later snapshots may differ from that fixed wait result. Work registered after an already completed wait cannot retroactively change its result. Reports retain primitive labels/status only, not values, raw errors, resources or Promises. This tracker performs no rendering, Game, storage or GPU operation.

note: Opt-in qa-owned-cleanup=1 plus own-data boundedOwnedCleanup:true: event-driven owned late-load retirement with one15second overall cleanup deadline outside all preparation/callback/readback timings. Original pixel and Game gates remain exact. A finalized primitive cleanup snapshot never changes after timeout; installed handlers may retire late resources best-effort. No optimization acceptance. Explicit own-data originalReadbackProbe:true and exact qa-original-readback=1: two fresh ORIGINAL arms, no candidate installer, preparation experiment or profiler. Keep the original final whole Canvas R0 and strict AA gate. Immediately reread the unchanged main Canvas R1; stop on any difference. Only stable R1 permits reading the existing floor F followed by unchanged main R2. No added render, simulation tick, pose selection or await between these reads. Floor read may flush/materialize its backing; it does not certify pre-blit floor pixels. Postprobe PNG is separate evidence, not certified to equal primary R0. Extra reads are quality diagnostics and all timings are ineligible as optimization evidence. 8851 genuine-memory QA only. Fresh owned Renderer/Art/native player and initial max-three-model NPC preparation per original/manual/original arm. Original on-demand species loads remain enabled; actual runtime model/pending maxima are reported. Main ready records are borrowed by identity and never loaded, masked or released through a mutating path. Forty fixed .12-second catch-up callbacks include their first draw; batch-eight rAF yields are reported separately. This is a renderer combat harness without app HUD, audio or persistence, not presented FPS. Certification and lifecycle wrappers are inside render timing in every arm; no Canvas-stage, native-stage or frame-cost observer is installed. Literal per-frame checkpoint/effects/motion/commands/events and both RNG states are compared outside timers. Final whole-canvas readback and PNG export follow the measured loop. Existing twelve-state/two-selected-cell pixel QA is separate evidence, not proof for every source frame. Shared URL decode caches and the live product caches remain resident; fresh instances do not imply cold driver/URL caches. Owned native pending promises are followed through late success/failure for retirement. A failed player Promise.all can have unobservable sibling requests; that failure is explicitly cleanup-unproven rather than called complete. Timings are CPU call wall, not GPU duration or peak memory. No product optimization is adopted by this utility.
